name: Dance of Clematis: Stem, Thorn and Flower

system.description:
You pour chakra across your entire skeletal structure as you manifest two special bone weapons, both of which you have proficiency in. The Clematis Vine and the Clematis Thorn.

Clematis Vine. This special weapon is a special whip formed from your spinal cord with the following traits (Damage: 1d8 Slashing, Weapon Properties: Reach 4, Trip, Finesse, Grapple, Weapon Group: Flail). Once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon attack using this weapon, you can force the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw, being Restrained on a failure. Affected creature can make a Strength saving throw at the end of their turns to end this effect on them.

Clematis Thorn. You pour chakra into your arm, over-calcifying it creating a large drill shaped bone that covers most of your arm starting at your elbow. This weapon is unique and has the following traits (Damage: 4d6 Piercing, Weapon Properties: Critical 2, Deadly 4, Reach 1, Special (Clematis Thorn) Special (Clematis Flower), Weapon Group: Power).

Special (Clematis Thorn): This weapon cannot be disarmed from you and Weapon or Taijutsu attacks made with this weapon are made at disadvantage, unless against a grappled creature, in which case attacks made with this jutsu is at advantage.

Special (Clematis Flower): This weapon cannot be used as part of a jutsu that affects an area.
